subject: PeopleOS Brief — July 14, 2026 Intelligence
preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: The Indian stock market ended flat today, driven by rallies in IT and media stocks. In the US, the Dow, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 saw mixed movements, while global markets reacted to ongoing geopolitical tensions and economic trends. Meanwhile, significant developments in AI and job markets emerged, with major companies making moves in AI and India's job market undergoing changes. The US job growth also slowed, prompting central banks to respond to inflation.
